`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Local.ringHomAbv`

Let $p$ be a natural number equipped with the assumption that $p$ is prime, let $F$ be a field whose underlying type lies in an arbitrary universe, and let $\tau:F\to\overline{\mathbb Q_p}$ be a ring homomorphism preserving $0$, $1$, addition, and multiplication. Here $\overline{\mathbb Q_p}$ is the fixed algebraic closure of the field of $p$-adic numbers, equipped with the spectral norm induced by the $p$-adic norm on $\mathbb Q_p$. The definition assigns to these data the real-valued absolute value $a_\tau:F\to\mathbb R$ given, for every $x\in F$, by $a_\tau(x)=\lVert\tau(x)\rVert$. Thus its underlying function is the composition of $\tau$ with this norm, bundled with the absolute-value conditions: for all $x,y\in F$, $a_\tau(x)\ge0$, $a_\tau(x)=0\iff x=0$, $a_\tau(xy)=a_\tau(x)a_\tau(y)$, and $a_\tau(x+y)\le a_\tau(x)+a_\tau(y)$.
